verdict.rationale: Activepieces can be driven without the UI through an API authenticated by Bearer API keys and a built-in MCP server that lets external clients build, test and manage flows. It also installs non-interactively via a one-line curl script or Docker Compose. However, nothing shows a CLI or documented CI/pipeline usage, API keys must be generated in the platform dashboard, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/pipeline integration, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
